Events

Event Calendar

By Jay Russell · October 7, 2026 · 1 min read

Oakland Zoo

Oaklandzoo.org 9777 Golf Links Rd, Oakland; 632-9525

The Oakland Zoo sets the standard for world-class animal care in captivity. Guests will marvel at the many species taking up residence at the zoo, while learning about conservation in the wild. The zoo is open every day from 9:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. Take the gondola to the amazing boardwalk of the California Trail, for viewings of wolves, buffalo and bears. Amusement rides, including a brand-new electric train, are open as well. Make sure to buy tickets in advance for timed entry.

Adventure Playground

Berkeleyca.gov 160 University Avenue, Berkeley; 981-6720

This unique playground will have kids entertained and engrossed in outdoor play for hours. The space is open Saturday and Sunday, 11:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. The playground features kid-designed and built forts, boats, and towers. Children under the age of 18 must have a supervising adult registered to attend and watch them during their time at the playground because this park lets kids create with hammers, saws, paint, and recycled materials.

Chabot Space & Science Center

Chabotspace.org 10000 Skyline Boulevard, Oakland; 336-7300

Chabot is now open Wednesday-Sunday, 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., for a full day of fun and exploring the out-of-this-world exhibits. Older kids will love the shows in the planetarium and MegaDome, the boldest way to experience space and science, on the biggest of big screens. Every Friday and Saturday night the Chabot Observatory Deck has a free telescope viewing 7:30 to 10:30 p.m., as well, weather permitting, check their website for visibility status. Cleardarksky.com/c/ChbtSPC-CAkey.html?1

Leona Canyon Hiking Trail

Ebparks.org/parks/leona Campus Drive off Keller Avenue, Oakland, CA

This East Bay Regional Park, just seven miles from Piedmont, is a hidden outdoor hiking gem. The pristine wooded canyon is protected in this 290-acre parkland near Merritt College in Oakland. It is a great place for hiking, running, dog walking and biking. Get outside of the house for a taste of fresh autumn air.
